response.sql: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(project_count) AS avg_project_count FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, SUM(ss.project_count) AS total_distinct_projects, AVG(ss.project_count - b.avg_project_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE ss.project_count > b.avg_project_count

assumptions.assumption: A zero boxz makes the ratio undefined, so that record is excluded from the ratio average.
